posts.bodyHtml:
1) What is your name? Real & Ingame - My name is Ivan , my name ingame is ShroudX
2) How old are you? Im 17 years old. On 17 july i will be 18.
3) Why do you want to join our administrative team? I love the dream servers. I mostly like the knife server. I want to help to other admins with work in the knife server. I met a half of admins in knife server and they are very good and friendly guys.
4) How long have you been playing on our servers? I play in knife server from around 2 mounths. I play everyday.
5) What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes? I have a lot of favourite hobbies, one of them is to play cs:go, drink beer, and other things.
6) Do you think of yourself as mature? I dont know im 17 but im think im mature, i can be seriuos.
7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before? Yea before 3 month i was administrator in other knife server and in Cs 1.6 i own my server. I know how the options work with menu or what to type in console. I have not big experience but im not like a full noob in admin work.
[8)] When do you play? (timetable of your average week) I play everyday from 14:00 am to around 00:00. At weekends i play 24/7 and always when im online in my steam im on teamspeak talk with other friendly admins and users from server. When i finish school at the end of this month i will play everyday 24/7 and if there is an work for doing i can help. If my steam is not online and i need to other admin for something i can give my Facebook or viber and etc.
9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?
First i will remark user 1 to stop and if he dont stop i will mute or kick him.
10) Strengths - One of my stengths is that i can be serious and im not corruptible. I dont trust to guys in server who says " admin user 1 play 2v1 slay him" i'm joining in spectators and im looking the user1. I can be helpfull.
11) Weaknesses - Im not very good at german speek, i studying it now.
12) Conclusion / Closing remark - If someone has something against me or a recommendation let say to me.
I hope if i get promoted to admin i will not do a mistakes or break the rules. But we learn from our mistakes. Regards and have a nice day 🙂
